dimensions.assessment: Affects all participants in group health plans and individual health insurance coverage utilizing prior authorization requirements across the United States.
dimensions.evidence: In the case of a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering group or individual health insurance coverage that imposes any prior authorization requirement

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative reporting and website publication burdens on health plans and issuers to track and disclose detailed approval, denial, and appeal metrics.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Secretary ... and make available on a public website of the plan or issuer the following information

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative compliance costs for health plans and federal agencies to collect and process disclosures, but does not specify exact federal appropriations.
Amends multiple major federal health statutes including the Public Health Service Act, ERISA, and the Internal Revenue Code.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XXVII of the Public Health Service Act, the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent transparency and reporting mandates for health plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: during a plan year beginning on or after January 1, 2027

missing_information: Specific estimates of the administrative costs to health plans and federal agencies.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates that group health plans and health insurance issuers publicly display and submit detailed prior authorization metrics, claim denial rates, appeal outcomes, and technology disclosures starting in 2027.
